capitalOfTheWorld.name: The Capital of the World
capitalOfTheWorld.note: Citizens living in your seat of government, buildings standing in it, and wonders among those buildings — all on the same turn.

workedLand.name: The Worked Land
workedLand.note: Everything the land worked by your seat of government pays you, added up over the age.

theHarvest.name: The Harvest
deferred: The food a farm pays is not yet told apart from the food the ground under it pays, so nothing can read this bar.
theHarvest.note: Food your farms pay across the realm, on one turn.

breadAndIron.name: Bread and Iron
breadAndIron.note: Food to spare across the realm and the fighting strength of every piece you have in the field — both on the same turn.

caravanserai.name: The Caravanserai
caravanserai.note: Everything your trade routes pay you, added up over the age.

kingsRoads.name: The King's Roads
kingsRoads.note: The gold your towns pay you for being joined by road to your seat of government, added up over the age.

solventRealm.name: The Solvent Realm
solventRealm.note: What your treasury takes in each turn once the realm's costs are paid, added up over the age.

warChest.name: The War Chest
warChest.note: Gold sitting in your treasury and the fighting strength of every piece you have in the field — both on the same turn.

academies.name: The Academies
academies.note: Learning made across the realm, added up over the age.

observatory.name: The Observatory
observatory.note: Learning made in one turn, shared out over every citizen in the realm.

theTithe.name: The Tithe
theTithe.note: Everything your religion pays the realm, added up over the age.

wonderOfTheAge.name: The Wonder of the Age
wonderOfTheAge.note: Wonders of the age the world is in now, standing in your towns — held at once.

marvelsPay.name: The Marvels' Pay
marvelsPay.note: Everything your wonders pay you, added up over the age.

patronage.name: The Patronage
patronage.note: Everything your great people pay you — their works, their gifts and their legacies — added up over the age.

theRenowned.name: The Renowned
theRenowned.note: Renown your realm earns over the age, spent or not, added up.

theChronicle.name: The Chronicle
theChronicle.note: Culture made across the realm, added up over the age.

theDeck.name: The Deck
theDeck.note: Everything the cards slotted in your government pay you, added up over the age.

marcherLords.name: The Marcher Lords
marcherLords.note: Towns you hold, contentment at or above nothing, and authority not yet overspent — all on the same turn.

theBuilders.name: The Builders
theBuilders.note: Everything the buildings across your realm pay you in one turn.

sixVoices.name: The Six Voices
sixVoices.note: Food, work, gold, learning, culture and faith, summed every turn and added up over the age.

contentedRealm.name: The Contented Realm
contentedRealm.note: Contentment to spare, counted every turn and added up over the age.

theArsenal.name: The Arsenal
deferred: The work a town puts behind a soldier is not counted apart from the rest of its work, so nothing can read this bar.
theArsenal.note: Work your towns put into building soldiers, added up over the age.

fieldOfGlory.name: The Field of Glory
fieldOfGlory.note: Rivals' soldiers you kill over the age, less your own soldiers lost.

takenTown.name: The Taken Town
takenTown.note: Towns you took by force this age and still hold.
